name: agent-storyboard
description: Start the local Agent Storyboard app, create and manage storyboard projects, process image and video generation tasks, and return assets to the right shot. Works in Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Open a local storyboard app, create storyboards, and generate image/video assets.
interface.longDescription: Agent Storyboard starts a bundled local storyboard app, then lets your agent create, find, update, and delete complete projects without browser automation. It reads pending shots, honors project aspect ratios and DESIGN.md, routes assets to image generation, HyperFrames, or Remotion, and returns outputs to the correct project and row. Agents without their own image generation (for example Claude Code) can generate through the local Codex CLI.
capabilities: B-roll motion planning and confirmation gate
defaultPrompt: Create a complete storyboard project from my video idea and write it into Agent Storyboard.
Process all pending storyboard generation tasks.
